name: Seduce Me: Happily Ever After
source:
"I was getting married and the world was waiting for me."

The church bell chimes and the guests await me for one of the most joyous occasions in my life. I am going to be wed to the man I love...

Is this a dream?

[From [url=https://vamichaelalaws.itch.io/seduce-me-the-otome-episode-series]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“我要结婚了，全世界都在等待我。”

教堂钟声响起，宾客们等待着我人生中最幸福的时刻之一。我将嫁给心爱的男人……

这是梦吗？
